question: What outcome regarding age and death follows from daily non-eating?
premises: Daily non-eating is the means described
The object is death by aging
The future verb indicates the resulting outcome
inference: Through daily non-eating, one will overcome death by aging.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is contextually interpreted as overcoming or passing beyond.
plain_english: By fasting day by day, one will overcome death by aging.
